busko_replication.comparison_absence: candidate position must be covered by at least two distinct scans of the comparison plate and have no calibrated APPLAUSE source within 5 arcsec on any comparison scan
busko_replication.positive_plate_scan_consistency: candidate must be detected on at least two distinct scans of the positive physical plate

independent_observatory_confirmation.independent_plate_coverage: candidate position must be covered by at least two distinct scans of the independent plate
independent_observatory_confirmation.primary_positive_scan_consistency: independent-observatory counterpart must be supported by at least two distinct scans

interpretation.next_required_stage: candidate-specific quality, sensitivity/injection and native-pixel validation before any transient claim

purpose: First source-level stage of the redesigned Busko-first experiment. Process every qualifying Tier-A (<=30 min) same-site comparison attached to the geographically independent APPLAUSE space-time opportunities, before inspecting any candidate outcomes.

selection.primary_physical_plate_exposure_rule: science plate A, science plate B, and comparison plate must each have numexp == 1; multi-exposure plates are held out because APPLAUSE source detections are scan/plate-level and cannot be uniquely assigned to one exposure.
